integrity: The theorem is proved analytically in RESULT.md; finite symbolic and numerical computations corroborate the derivation. The original 2022 baseline critical cutoff and generic exponentiated-CDF method are acknowledged as prior art; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive Haq rate and a sufficiently small positive CDF-exponentiation increment. Does not establish a complete all-parameter modal phase diagram, global maximality of both local modes, or hazard modality; existential epsilon threshold is not made uniform.
source_ids: Muhammad Ahsan-ul-Haq, Pakistan Journal of Statistics 38 (2022), 473–490
title: Two-mode onset and a sharp cusp threshold for the exponentiated Haq density
